note: IronChests sync-NBT bridge for the converted 1.21.1 jar. The 1.20.1 one-argument readNbt/writeNbt calls inside GenericChestBlockEntity no longer link, and the converted two-argument method bodies are swapped relative to their names: method_11007 writes the inventory into the tag while method_11014 clears and reads it from the tag. The bridge follows the bodies, not the names.

methodRedirects.evidence: First chest open (runs/p66-ironchests-gui/latest-model-shim.log): NoSuchMethodError 'void GenericChestBlockEntity.method_11007(class_2487)' at GenericChestBlockEntity.getSyncTag(GenericChestBlockEntity.java:192). getSyncTag must serialise the entity; in the converted class that behaviour lives in the two-argument method_11007 (class_1262.method_5426 writes), not in method_11014, whose body clears the inventory and reads the tag (runs/p70-ironchests-persist/README.md).

Same converted class: loadSyncTag(NbtCompound) calls the one-argument method_11014, which no longer links in 1.21.1. loadSyncTag applies a received tag to the entity; that behaviour lives in the converted method_11014 body (it clears items and calls class_1262.method_5429 to read the tag), as shown by the close/reopen test in runs/p70-ironchests-persist/README.md.
